shortDescription: Perform RavenDB node and cluster health checks

options.name: ca_cert_path
options.description: Path to a CA bundle used to validate the server certificate.

options.name: certificate_path
options.description: Path to a client certificate for secured clusters.

options.name: checks
options.description: List of health checks to run.

options.name: db_retry_interval_seconds
options.description: Interval in seconds between attempts for C(db_groups_available) and C(db_groups_available_excluding_target).

options.name: max_time_to_wait
options.description: Max time window in seconds for each selected check before timing out.

options.name: on_db_timeout
options.description: Behavior when C(db_groups_available) times out. C(fail) fails the task; C(continue) returns success with timeout noted in results.

options.name: retry_interval_seconds
options.description: Interval in seconds between attempts for C(node_alive) and C(cluster_connectivity).

options.name: url
options.description: Base URL of the RavenDB node to check, e.g. C(http://node-a:8080) or C(https://node-a:443).

options.name: validate_certificate
options.description: Verify the server TLS certificate when using HTTPS. Automatically disabled for IP hosts when running C(node_alive) or C(cluster_connectivity).
